faults.boundary: writer lock acquired before journal open
faults.required_result: next process reacquires the kernel lock; journal bytes remain unchanged; Redis is not attached

faults.boundary: journal header written before file sync
faults.required_result: torn or uncommitted journal cannot become ready and reopen fails closed

faults.boundary: journal file sync before first parent-directory sync
faults.required_result: directory sync is ordered before writable authority and PaperReady can escape

faults.boundary: RequestAccepted fsync before dispatch record
faults.required_result: restart preserves one accepted record and may append only the missing dispatch

faults.boundary: DispatchAttemptRecorded fsync before provider
faults.required_result: restart holds for reconciliation and never blindly redispatches

faults.boundary: provider effect before durable outcome
faults.required_result: durable provider witness exists and restart does not invoke provider again

faults.boundary: durable outcome before finalization
faults.required_result: restart reconstructs finalization and canonical ACK without provider

faults.boundary: RequestFinalized fsync before recovery seal
faults.required_result: restart reconstructs canonical ACK without provider

faults.boundary: recovery-seal temporary write
faults.required_result: orphan temporary data is never recovery authority

faults.boundary: recovery-seal temporary sync before rename
faults.required_result: old committed seal remains authoritative after SIGKILL

faults.boundary: recovery-seal rename before parent-directory sync
faults.required_result: rename is followed by directory sync and only exact canonical committed seal is accepted

faults.boundary: valid committed recovery seal before Redis settlement
faults.required_result: PEL remains and restart reconstructs settlement authority without provider

faults.boundary: atomic Redis settlement committed but response lost
faults.required_result: marker resolves the exact retry and no second canonical ACK is emitted

faults.boundary: ACK Redis settlement outage before commit
faults.required_result: PEL remains, backend degrades and XACK is not performed

faults.boundary: DLQ Redis settlement outage before commit
faults.required_result: poison entry remains pending, backend degrades and XACK is not performed

faults.boundary: new process killed during XAUTOCLAIM recovery
faults.required_result: fresh boot identity reclaims the complete old PEL from cursor 0-0

faults.boundary: abrupt death of writer lock holder
faults.required_result: kernel releases lock and next process validates storage before use

faults.boundary: external same-length journal mutation
faults.required_result: full frontier rescan detects mutation before append/effect

faults.boundary: journal sync failure after complete frame bytes
faults.required_result: no receipt or effect is authorized and current writer remains locked out

faults.required_result: RecoveryBlocked with no provider, settlement, XACK or journal truncation
